about: [O7 after the critic, B5] the quiet autosave without a car: two minutes on foot at no heat - written ('quiet', the SAVED tick); into a place's room at heat 0 - written as standing outside its street door.

steps.label: two minutes on foot, no car: the quiet autosave

steps.eval: (() => { const P = G.city.places, s = P.byId.get('diner'), o = s.frame.w(0, 2.4); G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(o.x, o.z); N.controller.setPose(o.x, o.z, s.frame.yaw(0), 0); window.__door = s.frame.w(0, 2.6); return [Math.round(o.x), Math.round(o.z)]; })()

steps.expect: G.night.saver.reason === 'room' && (() => { const d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('noir.save')); const p = d.city.pos; return Math.hypot(p.x - window.__door.x, p.z - window.__door.z) < 0.5; })()
steps.label: the room at heat 0: saved outside its street door
